sections.start: Across 1,656 paired video conversations , affect barely moves at the hello—then climbs.

sections.start: Affect and arousal both climb over the call.

sections.serves: Affect and arousal both climb over the call.

sections.start: These are averages, not a promise that every conversation improves.
